# The reference implementations pretrained-parity.yml compares against, pinned.
#
# Installed unpinned, they moved every week: from the 2026-10-20 run (green)
# to the 2026-11-03 one, torch 2.14.1 -> 2.15.0, transformers 5.20.2 ->
# 5.22.1, huggingface_hub 2.2.0 -> 2.4.0.  A week's result then said nothing
# about whether the next week's would match, and the two reds since could
# not be told apart from a changed reference by anything in the log.
#
# These are the versions of the last green run (2026-10-20).  scipy has no
# role in the numbers — DETR's hub entry point and the MaskFormer family
# import its Hungarian matcher at load time — but a moving scipy is as
# unreproducible as the rest.  torchvision is tied to torch's release, and
# huggingface_hub is the client whose downloads fail and retry.
#
# Bump them on purpose: change the versions together in one commit and let
# this file's pull_request trigger run the gate on the new stack, rather than
# finding out on a Tuesday.
torch==2.14.1
torchvision==0.29.1
timm==1.0.30
transformers==5.20.2
scipy==1.18.1
huggingface_hub==2.2.0
